reason: Reviewed the setup-copy change across all five surfaces. The prepared pairing message agents relay now says to scan the QR with the phone's camera, sign in with email if asked, check the code and approve, and keeps the proof-bearing link in the conversation only; harness-setup.md still tells agents to send it as written. Interactive init defers its hooks, command-approval and skill questions until no required gate is open, acting on explicit flags at once, so agents passing flags see no change. The device remedy names the missing sub-state (update, Settings, allow prompt, finish connecting) and the devices detail drops platform and permission jargon; technical.devices is unchanged. The default Machine name drops a trailing .local. Lifecycle hooks, readiness ids, statuses and JSON shapes and domain terms are unchanged.
